result.title: Machine Learning Beyond Statistical Consistency for Hybrid AI
result.summary: We propose a new definition of machine learning, according to which a machine learns a function when it computes the function successfully, that is, when the value it returns for each input has a proper derivation in a formal system. We extend Gödel's Representability Theorem, which equates computation with derivation, to empirical targets in two ways: the theorem is extended to the computable reals, and the data are admitted into the system as empirical definitions that record what has been observed. We prove that a machine learns a true probability if and only if two conditions are met. The Truth Condition is that its estimate converges to the true probability, which is statistical consistency. The Assurance Condition is that the machine properly derives its own convergence inside the system. Learning thus lies beyond statistical consistency, for it requires a derivation of the convergence from the record. A global assumption about the data, such as the i.i.d. assumption, does not supply such a derivation, because it leads only to a circular one, as we show for PAC learning. On the other hand, the two conditions are met for the probability of a sentence over a finite ideal corpus. A real machine can approximate a true probability only if an ideal machine can learn it precisely, that is, only in a domain that meets the two conditions. Modern AI works in such a domain, and we offer this as a clue to its success. Modern AI is hybrid as well, in two senses: First, it performs two kinds of tasks, namely probabilistic ones such as predicting the next word and deductive ones such as proving and coding. Second, it combines two parts of different kinds, a statistical proposer and a deductive verifier, for proving and coding. Our framework explains both senses of hybridity in one formal system.

AI.brief_summary: 论文重新定义机器学习：机器「学会」一个函数，是指在形式系统中能为每个输入返回的值给出推导；作者把 Gödel 可表示性定理扩展到可计算实数并把观测数据作为经验定义，证明学习真实概率需同时满足统计一致性（收敛）与「保证条件」（机器在系统内推导出自身收敛），据此解释概率提议加演绎验证的混合 AI 为何有效。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「保证条件」与 proposer–verifier 分工可能为 latent 推理轨迹的可验证性、验证器式证据筛选及停止决策提供概念线索，但论文高度形式化且无多模态实验，可供核查迁移价值。
